settings.content: Copy and tiers for the multi-buy progress bar in the cart drawer. It is hidden while the offer is switched off, and it appears on the Swedish market only. It states the offer, it does not grant it. These live in theme settings and not on a section because the cart drawer is rendered as a snippet, so there is no section to hang them on.

settings.label: Bottle size that counts
settings.info: The variant name of the size the offer is written for, spaces ignored. Only single bottles of that size count, the same unit the gift app counts: a multi bottle box ("5X 100ml") and a bottle sold without a size variant do not. Leave empty to count every line in the cart.

settings.label: Discount code, first tier
settings.info: The Shopify discount code that gives the first tier's gift (buy the first tier of bottles, get a 30 ml free). The test version puts it on the cart once the first tier is reached and takes it off again below it; the normal site never touches it. Leave empty and no code is applied.

settings.label: Discount code, second tier
settings.info: Same for the second tier's gift (the mystery 100 ml). Leave empty and no code is applied for it.

settings.label: Second tier gift, variant ID
settings.info: The variant the test version puts in the cart at the second tier (Gratis Mystik Parfym 100 ml). It goes in with the code above and comes out again below the tier, or straight away if the code does not make it free. Leave empty and the second tier adds nothing and applies no code.

settings.content: Write [n] where the number of bottles still needed should appear, and put the part that should stand out in green between asterisks.

settings.content: A swipe-based scent quiz shown as a popup site-wide. The visitor saves up to 6 favorites and is linked through to the bundle product with their picks pre-filled. On-site copy stays in Swedish; only these settings are in English.

settings.label: Bundle product
settings.info: Added to cart when a visitor taps "Build my bundle" after the quiz, with their picks recorded as line item properties, then taken straight to checkout. Required for that button - if left blank, it shows an inline error instead of adding to cart.

settings.label: Scent collection
settings.info: Required - products swiped through in the quiz deck. Until a collection with products is picked here, the trigger button stays visible but shows a notice instead of opening the quiz. Copy (tagline, "inspired by", mood tags, second photo) is read from each product's metafields where set - see the comment at the top of snippets/scent-quiz-popup.liquid for the exact fields.

settings.label: Variant to use
settings.info: For each product in the collection above, the variant whose title contains this text is used (e.g. "50" matches "50 ml"). Falls back to the product's first available variant if none match.

settings.label: Auto-open after
settings.info: 0 = auto-open disabled. Visitors can always open the quiz manually via the floating button.

settings.label: How often the popup should auto-open

Klaviyo public API key (Site ID)
settings.info: Klaviyo > Settings > API Keys > Public API Key. Safe to use in the browser.

settings.label: Klaviyo List ID
settings.info: The list the visitor's email should be added to. Klaviyo > Lists & Segments > open the list > List ID is in the URL.

settings.content: Search: our scent, scent family and price list

A search for a designer perfume (e.g. Sauvage) shows our scent in the same scent family on top, more scents of that family below, and, in Swedish (SEK) only, a price list: the searched perfume first and up to 4 others of the same family at Swedish retailers' prices (PRICE-COMPARE.md). A search for a house only (e.g. Creed) lists its scents under the related heading. Prices: the inspiration metaobject's retail_offers field, written by tools/retail-prices. {family}, {date} and {n} are filled in automatically.
